metadataRaw.title: Knee Arthritis Relief: 5 EASY Exercises for Pain & Stiffness
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows 5 easy exercises to help relieve knee arthritis pain and stiffness.

If you have knee osteoarthritis (wear-and-tear arthritis) and struggle with stiff, achy, or painful knees, these exercises are designed to help improve mobility and provide quick relief. Some may even start to feel good within 30 seconds.

Each exercise works the knee joint a little differently, so go through all five and use the ones that give you the most relief.

Give them a try and see which exercises help your knee arthritis pain and stiffness the most.

Link to oil: https://link.amazon/B009ycVZb

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:34 Knee Swings
2:26 Towel Press
4:18 Heel Slides
6:16 Muscle Scraping
10:01 Countertop Squats (Strengthening)
